walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 2: Performance — a core area of A-Level Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 2: Performance brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 2: Performance.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Whose 1953 Concentus Musicus Wien revived historically informed Baroque playing?
options: John Eliot Gardiner
Nikolaus Harnoncourt
Christopher Hogwood
Roger Norrington
Susan McClary
Christopher Small
Lawrence Kramer
Nicholas Cook

mcqs.q: What does 'piano' (p) mean as a dynamic marking?
options: Slow.
The instrument piano.
Quiet/soft.
ii to V.

mcqs.q: Which chords form a plagal cadence?
options: ii to V.
IV to I (the 'amen' cadence).
A long melody with no breaks.
V to I.

mcqs.q: What is a balanced antecedent-consequent phrase?
options: ii to V.
Any two phrases of similar style.
A long melody with no breaks.
Two phrases of equal length where the first sounds open (question) and the second resolves (answer).
